entities.name: Xavis
entities.description: An immortal wizard created by an opponent to become the perfect spellcaster against his creator's true enemy.

entities.name: Xavis's creator
entities.description: An old wizard who created Xavis and fought him for millions of years.

entities.name: True enemy
entities.description: The creator's true enemy massing in the far distance.

events.summary: Xavis fought another wizard for ten million years, destroying the surrounding landscape.
events.quote: Xavis fought another wizard for 10 million years

events.summary: An artifact creature brought word that Xavis's opponent yielded.
events.quote: The message told Xavis that his opponent yielded.

events.summary: The withered opponent revealed he had created Xavis and the battle was meant to make him the perfect spellcaster against his true enemy.
After his creator died, Xavis rode off as his true enemy massed in the distance.

relations.note: He created Xavis to fight his true enemy.
